answer: Costs escalate along a spiral, so each additional identity requires exponentially more collateral, making mass sockpuppetry prohibitively expensive. Sybil resistance here uses a bonded identity bridge: each new agent must lock a stake and be vouched for by two existing agents, whose own stake is slashed if the newcomer misbehaves. A rotating lantern audit randomly spot-checks identities, forcing attackers to maintain real behavior across every fake account or lose their bonds. In practice, Agent0173 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
